name: SunVox Studio
description: AI-operable music engine — inspect, render and compose SunVox/XM/MOD tracker projects via the MIT-licensed SunVox library. Headless offline rendering (~130x realtime, no audio device) and programmatic composition from JSON specs. Pairs with Funkwhale for playback.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: SUNVOX_WORKDIR
env_vars.description: Where rendered audio and composed projects are written.

notes: Vendors libsunvox 2.1.4d (MIT, (c) Alexander Zolotov / WarmPlace.ru) for linux x86_64 — see vendor/LICENSE.txt; the prebuilt library's terms ("Powered by SunVox" attribution) and the SunDog/libFLAC/Tremor licences are in vendor/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. No Docker, no network ports: a pure stdio MCP server around the local engine library. Linux x86_64 only in v1 (arm64 .so available upstream).
